Collection of Fell Cleave related features.
 Enable all for this to be an all-in-one Single Target Burst button.
WAR_FC_Infuriate_Desc: Adds Infuriate to Fell Cleave when available.
WAR_FC_InnerRelease_Desc: Adds Berserk / Inner Release to Fell Cleave when available.

NOTE: Will not use unless there is a target within range to prevent waste
WAR_Mit_ShakeItOff_Desc: Adds Shake It Off to the one-button mitigation.

Adds Thrill Of Battle to the one-button mitigation.
NOTE: even if disabled, will still try to use Thrill Of Battle as the lowest priority.
WAR_Mit_Vengeance_Desc: Adds Vengeance to the one-button mitigation.

WAR_Mitigation_Boss_RawIntuition_TankBus: Adds Raw Intuition/Bloodwhetting when tankbuster is detected.
WAR_Mitigation_Boss_Reprisal_Desc: Adds Reprisal when raidwide casting is detected.
WAR_Mitigation_Boss_ShakeItOff_Desc: Adds Shake it Off when raidwide casting is detected.
WAR_Mitigation_Boss_ThrillOfBattle_Desc: Adds Thrill of Battle when tankbuster is detected. Will not overlap unless below set threshold or aligned with rampart.
WAR_Mitigation_Boss_Vengeance_Desc: Adds Vengeance/Damnation when tankbuster is detected. Will not overlap with Rampart.

Options for Advanced Combos' In-Combo Mitigation.
Enable Mitigation in each Advanced Combo to use these options.
(Simple Mode does not use these Options, instead Recommended Values in place of them)
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_ArmsLength_Desc: Adds Arm's Length when 5 or more targets
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_Desc:
Adds Mitigation to the combos when not in a boss encounter. Will not overlap separate options unless stated.
Will not use mitigation in the first 15 seconds of a pull unless you are not moving.
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_Rampart_Desc: Adds Rampart when 3 or more targets
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_RawIntuition_Desc: Adds Raw Intuition/Bloodwhetting when available. Will overlap with others.
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_Reprisal_Desc: Adds Reprisal when 5 or more targets.
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_ShakeItOff_Desc: Adds Shake It Off for healing. Will not use when it would result in loss of Mitigation buffs.
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_ThrillOfBattle_De: Adds Thrill Of Battle when 3 or more targets
WAR_Mitigation_NonBoss_Vengeance_Desc: Adds Vengeance/Damnation when 5 or more targets
WAR_NascentFlash_Desc: Replace Nascent Flash with Raw intuition when level synced below 76.
WAR_NascentFlash_MO_Desc: If mousing over an ally in the UI, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
WAR_NascentFlash_TT_Desc: If your target's target is not you or in your party, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
WAR_PrimalCombo_InnerRelease_Desc: Turns Berserk / Inner Release into the Primal combo (Primal Rend -> Primal Ruination) on use.
WAR_RawIntuition_Targeting_Desc: If available, will replace the Raw Intuition/Bloodwhetting with Nascent Flash if you are hard targeting an ally.
WAR_RawIntuition_Targeting_MO_Desc: If mousing over an ally in the UI, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
WAR_RawIntuition_Targeting_Name: Raw Intuition to Nascent Flash Retargeting Feature
WAR_RawIntuition_Targeting_TT_Desc:
If your target's target is not you, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
(if you're not top aggro, and not mousing over or hard targeting an ally)
WAR_RetargetHolmgang_Desc: Will Retarget Holmgang to yourself, instead of letting it go on enemies.
WAR_RetargetOnslaught_Desc: Will retarget Onslaught to your field or UI mouseover target (If Hostile) or the nearest hostile target to your mouseover target (If friendly).
WAR_RetargetTomahawk_Desc: Will retarget Tomahawk to according to below settings.

Not advised outside of overworld content, as it can waste a lot of Low Blows on un-stun-able enemies, etc. Will try to not use it in boss fights.
WAR_ThrillEquilibrium_Desc: Replaces Equilibirum with Thrill of Battle when ready.

 Cure 3 replaces Cure 2 regardless of this setting as that is how SE made it

Adds Asylum placement, when standing still, to the rotation.
Will Retarget it onto yourself.

WHM_AoEHeals_Desc: Replaces Medica with a one button AoE healing setup.

Uses Medica II when heal target doesn't have Medica II buff.
Upgrades to Medica III when level allows.

WHM_AoE_DPS_Assize_Desc: Adds Assize to the AoE combo.

WHM_AoE_DPS_LilyOvercap_Desc: Adds Afflatus Rapture to the AoE combo when at three Lilies.
WHM_AoE_DPS_Lucid_Desc: Adds Lucid Dreaming to the AoE combo when below the set MP value if you are moving or it can be weaved without GCD delay.
WHM_AoE_DPS_Misery_Desc: Adds Afflatus Misery to the AoE combo when it is ready to be used.
WHM_AoE_DPS_PresenceOfMind_Desc: Adds Presence of Mind to the AoE combo
WHM_AoE_DPS_SwiftHoly_Desc:
Adds a Swiftcast->Holy at the beginning of your AoE rotation.
Requires you to already be in combat, to have stopped moving, and to not have used Assize yet.
WHM_AoE_Simple_DPS_Desc:
Replaces Holy with a full one-button AoE rotation. 
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.

Changes Cure II to Cure when synced below Lv.30.
Can be Retargeted with the Retargeting Features below.
WHM_Mit_AoE_Desc:
Changes Asylum into Temperance and then Divine Caress after use.
Can be Retargeted with the Retargeting Features below.
WHM_Mit_ST_Desc:
Changes Aquaveil into Tetragrammaton and/or Divine Benison after use.
Each action can be Retargeted with the Retargeting Features below.

Will try to Weave Asylum when a raidwide casting. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.
WHM_Raidwide_Desc:
Collection of tools designed to try and cast during a raidwide attack when detected.
This will work for most, but not all raidwide attacks and is no substitute for learning the fight
WHM_Raidwide_LiturgyOfTheBell_Desc:
Will try to weave Liturgy of the Bell when a raidwide casting. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.
WHM_Raidwide_LiturgyOfTheBell_Name: RaidWide Liturgy of the Bell Option
WHM_Raidwide_PlenaryIndulgence_Desc:
Will try to weave Plenary Indulgence when a raidwide casting. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.
WHM_Raidwide_Temperance_Desc:
Will try to Weave Temperance and Divine Caress when a raidwide casting. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.

WHM_Re_Asylum_Desc: Retargets Asylum to yourself (even from the Mitigation Feature above).
